purpose: Korean query-conditioned policy passage reading: relation, assertion status, monetary roles and supporting phrases. Independent personal research; no client material.
authoring: AI-assisted synthetic grammar and provisional official annotations; no independent human annotation completed.

semantics.asserted: The passage presents the event as settled or performed, not verified real-world implementation.
semantics.relation: The event being discussed, even if denied, hypothetical or planned. Denied policy_change is NOT an actual policy change.
semantics.money_roles: before and after are reference/proposed report positions, not evidence that proposed amounts took effect.
semantics.unspecified: Insufficient passage evidence for this axis; separate from model abstention.
semantics.query: Manually supplied target. No automatic document retrieval, entity discovery or full-document understanding claim.
semantics.under_review: Discussion or explicit non-finalization. Non-finalization alone does not prove an active review process.

data.official: Purposive passage audit reported separately; no population accuracy claim.

training.shared_initialization: All heads instantiated in all conditions; identical seed initializes identical encoder and heads. Unused head parameters receive no loss.
training.encoder_update: Only encoder layers 10 and 11 (zero-based); embeddings and lower 10 layers frozen. All classification heads instantiated; unused heads have no loss. 14,206,504 trainable parameters including unused heads.
training.amendment_reason: Post-hoc optimization adequacy comparison after observing weak first-regime synthetic scores. Encoder LR unchanged; new heads LR .001 and epochs 10 fixed once before these runs. Both interventions change; no isolated causal attribution. Same nine conditions and no checkpoint selection. Evaluation is now known development material.

loss: flat: CE(24 joint classes) + CE(money tokens); factor: CE(relation)+CE(state)+CE(money tokens); evidence: factor + 0.5 CE(evidence tokens). Different objectives; not identical loss scales or head capacity.

decoders.flat_marginals: Sum 24-way probabilities by each axis and take independent argmax, allowing unseen combinations; report alongside flat argmax.
decoders.numeric: For models' greedy money-role pair only: if both roles exist and unequal won, set restatement probability to zero and renormalize. No gold roles, no assignment to correction from inequality. Report as ablation, not theorem.

evaluation: support non-whitespace character micro F1 for evidence model
validation-selected abstention with per-relation and per-state coverage/error
Training-set accuracy and retained learning curves for adequacy diagnosis, not generalization evidence
abstention: Thresholds 0.00..0.99 in steps .01; confidence=min(max relation p,max state p,min per-amount role p), empty amounts omit role. Choose highest validation coverage with >=20 answers and joint+roles error<=5%; if none, answer zero. One threshold per run, no evaluation tuning.

stress.distractor: Add another named policy's correction denial with two amounts; target labels unchanged.
stress.units: Express every amount in won, preserving numerical value and role/evidence offsets.
stress.evidence_removed: Oracle diagnostic: replace annotated relation/status words with a neutral omission marker. Report decision retention and confidence drop, not task accuracy.

reporting: All seeds and negative outcomes. Row counts and normalized surface counts. Seed range is optimization variability, not population CI. Synthetic same-author grammar and unreviewed official labels prohibit real-world generalization claims. Existing v1/v2 are known development material. Freeze inputs, code, protocol before fitting. Subsequent fixes logged rather than silently overwriting frozen artifacts.
stop: Nine new fits at final epoch, no further result-driven tuning in this round; preserve both regimes and independent numerical verification.
